zh-CN.title: 更轻盈清晰的状态提示
items: 统一优化信息提示与空状态，去除虚线框并适配深浅色模式
更清楚地区分加载、空内容和读取失败，互动额度读取失败后可直接重试

en.title: Lighter, clearer status feedback
items: Refined information and empty states without dashed boxes, in light and dark themes
Clearer loading, empty and failure states, with a direct retry for interaction quotas
